description: This file defines the interface for handling PKCS#12 keystore operations, including loading a store, retrieving certificates and keys, and cleanup functions. It provides function declarations for managing cryptographic store objects in the context of a C project.

methods.name: p12StoreLoad
methods.description: Loads a PKCS#12 store from a specified file path with a passphrase, returning a pointer to a managed store object.

methods.name: p12StoreGetCert
methods.description: Retrieves the client certificate from the PKCS#12 store.

methods.name: p12StoreGetPEMKey
methods.description: Returns the private key in PEM format from the store.

methods.name: p12StoreGetPEMCACerts
methods.description: Retrieves additional CA certificates in PEM format, optionally including the root CA.

methods.name: p12StoreDestroy
methods.description: Frees the memory associated with a P12Store object.
